text: Most Americans can name all three branches of government.

room.label: 5C students
room.note: HUMAN: campus set — the room is the 5C survey; the Form asks the claim text verbatim (True / False / Not sure). Fill from the survey. VERIFY before setting verified: confirm the latest Annenberg Constitution Day figure (news reports of the 2026 survey give 65%, Aug 6–9, n=1,034) and replace the home-page URL with the specific release.

truthSource.label: Annenberg Public Policy Center, Constitution Day Civics Survey (2025)
